title: Laboratory and ordering directories
summary: Set the laboratory profile and register the clients and practitioners referenced by orders.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Laboratory profile records the performing laboratory’s report details and display time zone. Updating it creates a new version; changes after the first version require a reason.

Clients lists ordering organizations. Open a client for its locations and report destinations. Practitioners lists ordering practitioners and their supplied NPI. Use the corresponding add or register action when an authorized directory record is needed.

sections.title: Good practice
paragraphs: Check profile details against the laboratory’s approved information, including the time zone. Missing profile information can prevent report preparation, and times display in UTC until a profile is set.

Keep the performing laboratory, ordering client, client location and practitioner distinct. Use stable codes and the supplied identifiers to avoid selecting a similarly named record. A client’s destination still needs its separate verification workflow.

sections.title: If you cannot continue
paragraphs: Order entry needs configured clients and practitioners. If a record is missing, have a configuration administrator create it from an authorized source. Do not register a guessed practitioner or substitute a different client just to complete an order. Review the exact directory before adding another entry.

pages.title: Laboratory profile
pages.purpose: Maintain performing-laboratory details printed on reports and the time zone used throughout the app.
pages.access: Any signed-in person may read the profile; Manage configuration is required to save a new version.

fields.name: Laboratory name / Name
fields.meaning: Performing laboratory’s report name.
fields.values: Approved laboratory name.
fields.rules: Required; up to 200 characters.

fields.name: Address line 1 / Address
fields.meaning: First line of the performing laboratory’s postal address.
fields.values: Approved address text.
fields.rules: Required; up to 200 characters per line. One to three nonempty lines are stored.

fields.name: Address lines 2 and 3
fields.meaning: Additional address lines printed with the laboratory details.
fields.values: Approved address text or blank.
fields.rules: Optional; up to 200 characters each. Blank lines are omitted.

fields.name: CLIA number
fields.meaning: Certificate identifier printed with the laboratory’s identity.
fields.values: Two digits, D, seven digits.
fields.rules: Required. This is a format check, not verification of certificate scope or status.

fields.name: Laboratory director / Director
fields.meaning: Director name printed on reports.
fields.values: Approved name up to 200 characters.
fields.rules: Required; registration here does not confer clinical privileges on an application account.

fields.name: Phone
fields.meaning: Laboratory contact telephone as printed.
fields.values: Approved contact text up to 40 characters.
fields.rules: Required; stored as supplied after trimming.

fields.name: Time zone
fields.meaning: Zone used to display laboratory dates and times.
fields.values: A recognized IANA name, such as America/Chicago, or UTC.
fields.rules: Required; up to 64 characters. Fixed numeric offsets and informal abbreviations are refused. Saving refreshes time displays.

fields.name: Billing NPI
fields.meaning: Performing laboratory’s billing identifier.
fields.values: Ten digits with a valid NPI check digit, or blank.
fields.rules: Optional in the profile; other billing workflows may flag missing billing identity. A value that is not exactly ten digits is refused with “The NPI must be exactly 10 digits.”; ten digits whose last (check) digit does not match the other nine is refused with “This NPI is not valid. Please check the number for a typo.”

fields.name: Tax ID
fields.meaning: Tax identification number used for billing identity.
fields.values: Nine digits, optionally entered as NN-NNNNNNN, or blank.
fields.rules: Optional; stored without the hyphen.

fields.name: Version and Set
fields.meaning: Identify the current profile revision, who saved it and when.
fields.values: Increasing version number, recorded time and the account name of the person who set it; an account that cannot be found shows as user followed by its identifier.
fields.rules: Read-only; each successful change appends a version.

fields.name: Reason
fields.meaning: Why approved laboratory details are changing.
fields.values: Explanation up to 1,000 characters.
fields.rules: Required after the first saved profile; the initial profile has no reason.

actions.name: Set laboratory profile / Change profile
actions.does: Open the form, prefilled from the current profile where present.
actions.result: Save profile appends a new version; Cancel closes without saving.

actions.name: Save profile
actions.availableWhen: Valid required values and the current profile revision.
actions.result: The new version becomes current and the display time zone refreshes.

restrictions: Reports cannot be prepared until a profile is set; times display in UTC until then.
Changing the profile preserves older versions; it does not establish laboratory accreditation or validate clinical use.
workflow: Check the performing laboratory’s approved details.
Set or change the profile and explicitly select its IANA time zone.
Supply a reason for a revision, save, then confirm the displayed details and version.

troubleshooting.problem: Time zone or NPI is refused
troubleshooting.recovery: Use a recognized IANA name or the supplied ten-digit NPI with correct check digit; do not substitute a guessed value. “This NPI is not valid” means the ten digits fail the check-digit test, usually a typo: compare each digit with the source.

troubleshooting.problem: Another profile version was saved meanwhile
troubleshooting.recovery: Reload the profile and compare the latest details before retrying your change.

pages.title: Clients
pages.purpose: Find ordering organizations and register new authorized clients.

fields.name: Find clients
fields.meaning: Search existing organizations before registration.
fields.values: Code or name text; blank shows all.
fields.rules: Optional.

fields.name: Code
fields.meaning: Stable laboratory identifier for the ordering client.
fields.values: Laboratory-assigned code; use the displayed letters/digits/period/underscore/hyphen convention.
fields.rules: Required; up to 64 characters and unique among retained clients. Correct factual mistakes from the client detail page; records are never deleted.

fields.name: Name
fields.meaning: Human-readable label staff see when selecting the record.
fields.values: Laboratory-approved text.
fields.rules: Required; up to 200 characters; surrounding spaces are removed and control characters are refused.

fields.name: Locations
fields.meaning: Count of registered sites under the organization.
fields.values: Whole-number count.
fields.rules: Read-only; inspect or add sites on the client page.

fields.name: Availability / Revision
fields.meaning: Shows whether this retained directory identity may be selected for new orders and which correction revision is displayed.
fields.values: Active or Retired; positive revision number.
fields.rules: Read-only in the directory. Correct client, Correct location or Correct practitioner changes availability with a required explanation. Retired records remain available in configuration and historical lookups.

actions.name: Add client
actions.does: Register an ordering organization from its authorized code and name.

actions.name: Open row
actions.does: Open the selected organization’s details, locations and destinations.
actions.result: Shows the client page with navigation back to the directory.

restrictions: A client is an organization; it is distinct from the ordering practitioner and the performing laboratory.
workflow: Open the existing client or add its approved code and name.
Review its locations and delivery destinations before using it in orders.

troubleshooting.problem: A similar or duplicate client exists
troubleshooting.recovery: Compare the supplied identifiers before adding another record; do not use a similarly named organization as a substitute.

pages.title: Client details
pages.purpose: Maintain locations and view active report destinations for one ordering organization.
pages.access: Manage configuration is required to add or correct clients, locations and destinations.

fields.name: Code and Name
fields.meaning: Identify the selected client organization.
fields.values: Saved client code and display name.
fields.rules: Read-only; verify these before adding related records.

fields.name: Location Code
fields.meaning: Site identifier within this client.
fields.values: Laboratory-assigned code, up to 64 characters.
fields.rules: Required in Add location; unique within the client.

fields.name: Location Name
fields.meaning: Human-readable name of the client’s site.
fields.values: Approved site name up to 200 characters.
fields.rules: Required, up to 200 characters. Open the location row to correct supplied facts or retire the selection; earlier facts remain in history.

fields.name: Delivery destinations
fields.meaning: Active recipient addresses attached to this client.
fields.values: Client/location, label, channel, address and verification state.
fields.rules: Read-only preview excludes retired destinations; open a row for its full actions.

fields.name: Client
fields.meaning: Ordering organization this destination serves.
fields.values: A registered client chosen by name and code.
fields.rules: Required when adding from the directory; preset when adding from a client page. Changing it clears Location.

fields.name: Location
fields.meaning: Restrict the destination to one site of that client.
fields.values: Registered locations belonging to the selected client; blank means Whole client.
fields.rules: Optional; a location from another client is refused.

fields.name: Channel
fields.meaning: Staff-operated route used to send or hand over the report.
fields.values: Fax; Email; Mail; Courier; Pickup at the laboratory.
fields.rules: Required for a new destination. A replacement retains the original client, location and channel.

fields.name: Address
fields.meaning: Where the report is sent or handed over.
fields.values: Fax: 7–20 digits with spaces, +, -, parentheses or periods. Email: one address with an @ and dotted domain. Mail: postal address. Courier: optional handover description. Pickup: blank.
fields.rules: Up to 500 characters. Required for Fax, Email and Mail; optional for Courier; forbidden for Pickup. Format acceptance does not verify the recipient.

fields.name: Label
fields.meaning: Name staff use to distinguish this destination.
fields.values: Specific label such as the clinic’s authorized main fax.
fields.rules: Required; up to 200 characters.

fields.name: How it was verified
fields.meaning: Evidence that the address reaches the intended client.
fields.values: Description of the actual verification method.
fields.rules: Required to Verify; up to 500 characters. Do not record a test or contact that did not occur.

fields.name: Reason
fields.meaning: Explanation for replacing or retiring a destination.
fields.values: Specific explanation up to 1,000 characters.
fields.rules: Required for Replace and Retire.

fields.name: Self-verification confirmation
fields.meaning: Acknowledgement that the destination’s creator is also its verifier.
fields.values: Initially unchecked confirmation shown when requested by the engine.
fields.rules: Only accepted when the laboratory’s separation-of-duties policy allows it.

fields.name: Availability / Revision
fields.meaning: Shows whether this retained directory identity may be selected for new orders and which correction revision is displayed.
fields.values: Active or Retired; positive revision number.
fields.rules: Read-only in the directory. Correct client, Correct location or Correct practitioner changes availability with a required explanation. Retired records remain available in configuration and historical lookups.

fields.name: Correct client / Correct location: Code, Name, Availability for new orders, Reason
fields.meaning: Corrects the same organization or site using supplied evidence, or retires it from new ordering.
fields.values: Current code/name prefilled; Active or Retired preselected to current state; initially blank explanation.
fields.rules: Code 1–64 characters, name 1–200, reason 1–1000; all required. Code remains unique among retained clients or within the original client for locations. A location cannot move to another client.

fields.name: Correction history: Revision / Saved facts / Recorded / Recorded by / Reason
fields.meaning: Shows original registration and each factual correction or retirement in causal revision order.
fields.values: Saved code/name or NPI/names and availability; timestamp, the acting person’s account name (an account that cannot be found shows as user followed by its identifier), explanation.
fields.rules: Read-only and immutable. Migrated baseline shows Unknown — legacy baseline: its retained creation time does not establish earlier edit chronology or an author. No historical attribution is invented.

actions.name: Add location
actions.does: Register a site under this client.
actions.availableWhen: Manage configuration and a unique location code.
actions.result: The new site appears in Locations and relevant location choices.

actions.name: Add destination
actions.does: Open destination registration with this client already selected.
actions.result: Creates an unverified address; see Delivery destinations for verification and replacement requirements.

actions.name: Open destination
actions.does: Open the destination’s full detail panel.
actions.result: Navigates to Delivery destinations for Verify, Replace or Retire as permitted.

actions.name: Previous / Next / Clients breadcrumb
actions.does: Move between clients or return to the originating directory.
actions.availableWhen: A neighboring record or directory link is available.
actions.result: Navigation only; saved directory data is retained.

actions.name: Open location row / Correct location / Correct client / Save correction
actions.does: Opens current facts and submits a versioned correction or retirement.
actions.availableWhen: Manage configuration, current revision, unique code, at least one changed Code, Name or Availability value, and required evidence-backed reason.
actions.result: Updates the same identity and appends immutable history and audit. New order selections exclude retired records; accepted orders and issued PDFs remain retained.

actions.name: Show correction history / Hide correction history
actions.does: Loads or hides the selected record’s retained revision history.
actions.availableWhen: The client or practitioner detail or location panel is open.
actions.result: Shows all saved versions in revision order; opening history changes no records. In a side panel, the panel widens as far as the window allows while keeping the list at least 38rem wide, so all columns fit; you can still drag its left edge. Hide correction history returns the panel to its earlier width. A value shortened with … shows its full text when you point at it.

actions.name: Cancel
actions.result: No correction, retirement or history entry is recorded.

restrictions: A saved location is separate from a verified report destination; adding one does not establish the other.

Corrections must describe the same organization, site or practitioner. Use a distinct registration for a different identity. Retirement prevents new selection; it does not revoke or rewrite accepted orders or issued report artifacts.
workflow: Add only sites supplied by the organization.
Add authorized delivery destinations, then complete their verification separately.
For factual correction or retirement, open the existing record, inspect its history, choose Correct, enter supported facts and a reason, save, and verify the new availability and revision.

troubleshooting.recovery: Return to Clients and open a current row.
This preview hides retired addresses. Check Delivery destinations with Show retired before registering a replacement.
A correction must change at least one value; the engine saves nothing, so no revision or history entry is added. Change the value the evidence supports, or Cancel.

troubleshooting.problem: The record changed, or a retired source is refused for a new order
troubleshooting.recovery: Reload and inspect the current record/history before resubmitting a correction. Select an active source only when supported by the ordering evidence; do not substitute another organization or practitioner to bypass retirement.

pages.title: Practitioners
pages.purpose: Register ordering practitioners using their supplied identity and NPI.
pages.access: Manage configuration is required for registration, correction and retirement.

fields.name: Find practitioners
fields.meaning: Locate an ordering professional.
fields.values: Name or NPI text; blank shows all.
fields.rules: Optional; check before registering.

fields.name: NPI
fields.meaning: Practitioner identifier used to distinguish ordering professionals.
fields.values: Exactly ten digits with a valid NPI check digit. The field hint reads “10 digits. The last digit is checked automatically.”
fields.rules: Required and unique. Fewer or more than ten digits, or any other character, shows “The NPI must be exactly 10 digits.” Ten digits whose last (check) digit does not match the other nine shows “This NPI is not valid. Please check the number for a typo.” Format validation does not verify licensing, enrollment or authorization to order.

fields.name: Family name
fields.meaning: Practitioner’s supplied surname.
fields.values: Text up to 200 characters.
fields.rules: Required; shown first in the directory.

fields.name: Given names
fields.meaning: Practitioner’s supplied given names.
fields.values: Text up to 200 characters, or blank.
fields.rules: Optional; absent values show Not provided.

fields.name: Availability / Revision
fields.meaning: Shows whether this retained directory identity may be selected for new orders and which correction revision is displayed.
fields.values: Active or Retired; positive revision number.
fields.rules: Read-only in the directory. Correct client, Correct location or Correct practitioner changes availability with a required explanation. Retired records remain available in configuration and historical lookups.

fields.name: Correct practitioner: Availability for new orders / Reason
fields.meaning: Retires or reactivates selection of this same practitioner and explains any factual correction.
fields.values: Active or Retired, prefilled to current state; initially blank reason.
fields.rules: Required; reason 1–1000 characters. NPI and names are prefilled and retain their ordinary validation. Never transfer an existing identity to another person.

fields.name: Correction history: Revision / Saved facts / Recorded / Recorded by / Reason
fields.meaning: Shows original registration and each factual correction or retirement in causal revision order.
fields.values: Saved code/name or NPI/names and availability; timestamp, the acting person’s account name (an account that cannot be found shows as user followed by its identifier), explanation.
fields.rules: Read-only and immutable. Migrated baseline shows Unknown — legacy baseline: its retained creation time does not establish earlier edit chronology or an author. No historical attribution is invented.

actions.name: Register practitioner
actions.does: Save the supplied NPI and names.
actions.availableWhen: Manage configuration; NPI is valid and unused.
actions.result: Opens the registered practitioner panel with current facts and correction history.

actions.name: Open row / Previous / Next / Close
actions.result: Shows or navigates the panel. Correct practitioner is available to configuration managers; no deletion is offered.

actions.name: Correct practitioner / Save correction
actions.does: Records corrected supplied names/NPI or availability on the same practitioner identity.
actions.availableWhen: Manage configuration, current revision, valid unique NPI, at least one changed NPI, name or Availability value, and required reason.
actions.result: Appends immutable prior/current facts and actor audit. Retired practitioners disappear from new order choices; historical lookup and accepted orders remain.

actions.name: Show correction history / Hide correction history
actions.does: Loads or hides the selected record’s retained revision history.
actions.availableWhen: The client or practitioner detail or location panel is open.
actions.result: Shows all saved versions in revision order; opening history changes no records. In a side panel, the panel widens as far as the window allows while keeping the list at least 38rem wide, so all columns fit; you can still drag its left edge. Hide correction history returns the panel to its earlier width. A value shortened with … shows its full text when you point at it.

actions.name: Cancel
actions.result: No correction, retirement or history entry is recorded.

restrictions: Do not guess an NPI or substitute another ordering practitioner to unblock an order.

Corrections must describe the same organization, site or practitioner. Use a distinct registration for a different identity. Retirement prevents new selection; it does not revoke or rewrite accepted orders or issued report artifacts.
workflow: Search by the supplied NPI and name.
If absent, obtain authorized details and register the practitioner.
Check the saved identity before selecting it on an order.
For factual correction or retirement, open the existing record, inspect its history, choose Correct, enter supported facts and a reason, save, and verify the new availability and revision.

troubleshooting.recovery: Open the existing practitioner and confirm identity.

troubleshooting.problem: This NPI is not valid. Please check the number for a typo.
troubleshooting.recovery: The number has ten digits, but its last (check) digit does not match the other nine, which usually means a mistyped or swapped digit. Compare each digit with the source and correct it; do not change digits only to make the check pass.
A correction must change at least one value; the engine saves nothing, so no revision or history entry is added. Change the value the evidence supports, or Cancel.

troubleshooting.problem: The record changed, or a retired source is refused for a new order
troubleshooting.recovery: Reload and inspect the current record/history before resubmitting a correction. Select an active source only when supported by the ordering evidence; do not substitute another organization or practitioner to bypass retirement.
